## About
Scott's Car Care is a neighborhood shop at 101 S Railroad St, right at Main, in Lewisville. Our approach is simple: honest repair at fair prices. We work on domestic and import cars, SUVs and light trucks, including European, and we use the best parts available.
Customers know Scott by name. One reviewer has been coming since they moved to town and says he has always been "fair, honest and timely." One more came in on a co-worker's recommendation, has stayed with Scott through every car since, and brought the whole family along. Scott's Car Care holds a 4.8 rating from 25 Google reviews.
Give us a try. Call (972) 221-3966 and we'll get your vehicle on the schedule.

## Services
- Air conditioning: AC diagnosis and repair, with the equipment to handle both refrigerant systems we service.
- Electronics diagnostics and repair: Including check engine lights and emissions failures.
- Brake repair (including ABS): Brake work, including anti-lock brake systems.
- Fuel injection and tune up: Fuel system service and tune ups to keep your engine running right.
- Heating and cooling system repair: Repairs to your vehicle's heating and cooling systems.
- Electrical repair: Power windows, locks, SRS, antennas and more.
- All factory maintenance: The maintenance your vehicle's manufacturer calls for.
- Wheel hub/axle bearing pressing: Pressing wheel hubs and axle bearings in the shop.

## FAQ
Q: What kinds of vehicles do you work on?
A: Domestic, Asian and European vehicles, including cars, SUVs and light trucks.

Q: Can you help with a check engine light or a failed emissions test?
A: Yes. Our electronics diagnostics and repair covers check engine lights and emissions failures.

Q: Do you do oil changes?
A: One longtime customer says Scott now handles their oil changes after fixing problems a quick oil change place left behind.

Q: What fuel should I use?
A: We recommend TOP TIER rated fuels. They carry the recommended cleaners to help keep your fuel and intake systems cleaner and help prevent costly repairs.
